title: Recognize Your Power
coreMove: Notice the instant you start treating the obstacle as a verdict, then reclaim the small but real power to name what is happening more accurately.
sourcePressure: This chapter belongs to Perception, so it must teach cleaner seeing before it teaches action or endurance. Source sidecar ch01 exists and provides partial-source support only; no full text is frozen. For "Recognize Your Power", the pressure is to teach this exact move: Notice the instant you start treating the obstacle as a verdict, then reclaim the small but real power to name what is happening more accurately.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: The weak version turns the chapter into generic mindset advice instead of a precise discipline of reading the obstacle cleanly. For "Recognize Your Power", avoid replacing the chapter move with the whole book thesis.

sourceAnchors.detail: Frozen notes place Rockefeller in the Perception section as an anchor for steadiness and objectivity under pressure; no detailed scene is lawfully frozen.
